messages.author: ab7b24da45678eac
messages.subject: wishart and inv_wishart distribution
parts:
I have some problems with wishart distribution and inv_distribution.
I am trying to specify the bugs examples that involve (inv_)wishart
distribution
the same as in Bugs under different paramterizations. But the results
do
not match. So I take a look of samples directly from (inv_)wishart.

(wishart.stan and inv_wishart.stan were added in
src/models/basic_distributions)

For the wishart example, I have
W ~ Wishart(4, S), where
S = diag(2, 1, .5), so E(W) = 4 * S.

But the sample mean of 50,0000 iterations are
Mean SD
W.1.1 3.982929 3.9391
W.1.2 0.102395 1.9754
W.1.3 0.007455 1.3989
W.2.1 0.102395 1.9754
W.2.2 1.982580 2.0153
W.2.3 -0.033714 0.9883
W.3.1 0.007455 1.3989
W.3.2 -0.033714 0.9883
W.3.3 0.986565 0.9780

For inv_wishart, I have
W ~ inv_wishart(5, S), with the same S as above,
so E(W) = S / (5 - 3 - 1) = S.

And the sample statistics are:
Mean SD
W.1.1 0.648975 0.6724
W.1.2 -0.002066 0.3157
W.1.3 0.003248 0.2148
W.2.1 -0.002066 0.3157
W.2.2 0.329084 0.3687
W.2.3 -0.005003 0.1539
W.3.1 0.003248 0.2148
W.3.2 -0.005003 0.1539
W.3.3 0.162106 0.1692

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] wishart and inv_wishart distribution
parts:
Jiqiang -- you're one step ahead of us -- Daniel
and I were just talking about adding
tests for expectations (and second moments) for
all of the basic distributions.

It looks like an off-by-two error (we seem to get
a lot of those), so hopefully it won't be too
hard to track down.

I just took a quick look and the propto calcs
were way off. I'm fixing and will test, but that
could be the cause of the problem.

- Bob
